witnessStateAfterThisRun.whyNonZero: W2 stays in ARMS exactly as it was. A failed arm is recorded, never removed, so the witness as a whole still carries one and the harness still exits non-zero. W2-prime does not erase W2.
witnessStateAfterThisRun.discharge: whether six-of-seven with W2 explained but failed discharges the pre-registered condition blocking the twelve-repository walk is the owner’s ruling. The original pre-registration did not anticipate a replacement arm, so nothing in it decides the question either way.
witnessStateAfterThisRun.residualThatTravels: W2-twenty failed and is not erased; any claim about this witness carries that, together with the census finding that the null came from a redundant segment rather than an idle one or a blind check.
